page.layout: Top: two circular portrait medallions side by side, each with a legend around the rim (left: D. IVD. HIRCANVS; right: ARISTOBO / LVS D. IVD.). Below them: one column of running text at full width, with two paragraphs. No margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top left.

main_text.l: D. IVD. HIRCANVS
ARISTOBO
LVS D. IVD.
HYRCANVS, qui & Ioannes, supradicti Simonis filius,
patri succeßit, Dúxque populi fuit anno mundi 3831. ante Chri-
stum natum 131. Hic summa cum laude populo praefuit, vitae
suae insidiātes, à Ptolemaeo missos, occidit. Antiochus Soter, qui
& Pius, Hircanum Ierosolymis obsedit, accepta tandem pecunia
obsidionem soluit. Hyrcanus Dauidis sepulchrum aperuit, in-
gentes thesauros reperit, quibus Iudaeorum caepit peregrinos
alere. Cum Rom. foedus renouauit. Cognita Antiochi morte,
Samariam, quae rursum à Iudaeis defecerat, obsedit, ac post an-
num captam, solo aequauit. magnas opes cumulauit (nam à Re-
gibus Syriae, qui inter se certabat, liber factus, nullum iis vecti-
gal ab Antiochi morte pendebat) quinetiam ciuitates Idumaeae
domuit. Vide 1. lib. Macha. ca. 16. Iose. lib. Antiqui. 13. à ca. 13. ad
18. Fuit Hyrcanus Dux, summus sacerdos, ac Propheta: rexit
an. 25. Iose. ait 31.
ARISTOBVLVS Hyrcani filius, mortuo patre princi-
patum & sacerdotium suscepit, anno mundi 3857. ante Christum
natum 105. Hic Magistratum ad regiam dignitatem transtulit,
primúsque, post captiuitate Babylonicam, diadema sibi impo-
suit. Crudelis, fratres in vinculis tenuit & matrem quâ penuria
cõsumpsit: fratrem Antigonû nefariè occidi curauit, ad turrim
Stratonis clam collocatis sicariis. Ituraeos subegit, plurimámq;
eorum prouinciam Iudeis adiecit. Corruptis postquam annum
imperat, visceribus, copiámque sanguinis euomens, decidit in
eundem locum qui sanguine fratris asperfus erat, ibíque fra-
ternos manes, miserè moriens, placat. Iose. li. Anti. 13. ca. 18.

page.notes: Medallion legends are printed in the rims of the two engraved portraits; the star ornament after HIRCANVS is omitted. Number spacing in "3 8 3 1" and "1 3 1" in the first paragraph is normalised to 3831 and 131. "insidiātes" and "Iudeis" are read from a slightly blurred scan. The word "insidiates" carries a possible macron that is hard to confirm. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, including "Iose." for the printed "Iosfe." Printing errors such as "Iturraeos" in the original spelling "Ituraeos", "Corruptis" and the mixed spacing of "Antiqui. 13" are left as printed where legible.
